reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Doesn’t work like it used to cause now you want paid for it

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: Impossible to get ride of constellation mode to find satellites and planets. Total beating to use now

reviews.title: It is cluttered
reviews.text: Other reviews say how it’s not cluttered, but I found it to be very cluttered. And new things would start showing up in the interface that I didn’t know what they were. I didn’t know how to turn them off, just random things when updates what happened. All of a sudden it was in dark mode and I had no idea why.

reviews.title: Ads really?
reviews.text: I don’t need to be locked up watching BS ads for games in the middle of looking for a planet. 2x in 3 mins.

reviews.title: Constellations block view of plants
reviews.text: Make music and constellation fog display, optional and off by default.

reviews.title: Location unknown
reviews.text: How do I enter in my location so that I am getting correct information?

reviews.title: Very poor instructions
reviews.text: This is not even an app for a novice. No instructions whatsoever. I was trying to see the strawberry moon. I could see it with the naked eye but the app had me in a totally different quadrant. Not worth it at all.

reviews.title: Was great
reviews.text: I was a big fan of this app and used it quite often, sadly as of late the app keeps freezing and becoming unusable. It’s very frequent and frustrating, I have like 30 seconds of use before this happens IF I’m lucky. Please fix this, I’ve tried deleting and reinstalling multiple times and did everything I could to make sure it’s not in my end

reviews.title: The star constellations are making hard to just see the planets
Unable to cancel
reviews.text: Make it difficult to cancel subscription just FYI

reviews.title: Terrible money grab
reviews.text: you can’t even explore the app to try and learn it, without being bombarded with ads. The devs are looking for money, not to assist Astro-enthusiasts. Stay away from this terrible app. Positive reviews are likely bots and/or shills.

reviews.title: Stargazing Index not working
reviews.text: This app was a 5stars but all of the sudden, the stargazing index is almost always at 95% with no clouds and it’s clearly not like that. I just to trust the index even if it was 75% but now, even at 99%, I can’t trust it

IT IS GIVING ME FALSE INFORMATION! IT IS HORRIBLE!!
